# Transparency effects (`theme.transparency`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Personalization · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Turns transparency effects on or off.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | true / false | no |  | true to enable transparency effects. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: theme.transparency
    enabled: false
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted.
